ESTA_CRON_ARGUMENTS: nightly invoicing argument guard; only the cron route calls it

ESTA_ISSUE_ARGUMENTS: issue function argument guard; only the invoicing job calls it

ESTA_LEASE_NOT_DRAFT: lease function guard; the screen offers activation on drafts only
ESTA_LEASE_STATUS_THROUGH_FUNCTION: lease trigger forcing status changes through functions; a direct write only
ESTA_LEASE_TERMS: bill preview argument guard; the form validates first
ESTA_LEASE_TERMS_LOCKED: lease trigger on terms of a started lease; the edit screen hides those fields
ESTA_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT: statement import guard on the receiving account; the import screen picks from the household's own accounts
ESTA_PAYMENT_KEY_MISSING: statement import guard; the import always builds a key
ESTA_PAYMENT_METHOD: payment method guard; the sheet offers cash and bank transfer only
ESTA_PAYMENT_NOT_UNDOABLE: reachable: undoing a payment past its window; undoPayment answers ok false without naming the cause
ESTA_READING_IDENTITY: meter reading identity trigger; a direct write only
